key.query: What is the role of mitochondria in plant programmed cell death and leaf remodelling?

evidence.title: PubMed 22968828 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: loss of Lon1 significantly modifies respiratory function and plant performance by small but broad alterations in the mitochondrial proteome gained by subtly changing steady-state protein assembly, stability, and damage of a range of components that debilitate an anaplerotic role for mitochondria in cellular carbon metabolism.

evidence.title: PubMed 11032171 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: Programmed cell death plays an important role in maintaining homeostasis during animal development, and has been conserved in animals as different as nematodes and humans.

evidence.title: PubMed 23625539 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: Inducing programmed cell death (PCD) is a promising method to prevent or inhibit the progression of tumor cells. Intricate cross talk among various programmed cell death pathways including cell death by apoptosis, necroptosis or autophagy plays a critical role in the regulation of PCD.
